query: What medical expenses related to accidents are included under the MediShield Life Scheme?
reference_answer: Dental work is covered under the MediShield Life Scheme only if required due to accidental injuries.
context:
[Document 1]
Dental work is covered under the MediShield Life Scheme only if required due to accidental injuries.

[Document 2]
A summary of the key features of the MediShield Life Scheme can be found in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet.

[Document 3]
The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015.

[Document 4]
The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on the claimant's age and choice of ward class.

[Document 5]
The information in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet is correct as of 1 April 2025.
answer: Under the MediShield Life Scheme, dental work related to accidental injuries is covered. However, other medical expenses are not specified in the given information. [Document 1]
